text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the last day of a productive summer camp and Tamamo Cross has poured countless hours into perfecting her new running form…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What do ya think, Trainer? My new form's startin' to shape up real nice, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All I gotta do now is toughen up my lower body. Is there any way we can speed up the process?
choice_data_list: That growth will come naturally. Let's be patient.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Naturally… Geez, talk about a cruel world…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, you are still a child, Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, she is. I see a lot of Tome's nephew in her…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hold on a sec! I don't wanna be treated like some kid by a couple runners still in their junior year!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And how come it's gotta be her nephew, huh? Ya coulda just said "niece," y'know!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What?! Tome has… a niece?! I had no clue…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Graaah! Dat's NOT what I'm sayin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that comeback, our fun-filled time at summer camp comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Anyhoo, how ya been, Oguri? Didja solve that runnin' problem ya had?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my cornering's gotten a lot better. And I'll keep working on it little by little once I've debuted in the Twinkle Series…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm nowhere near your level, Tama. But I'll keep trying.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gotcha. It might sound uppity comin' from someone who was just beggin' you for help, but…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You've got this in the bag! I know you'll overcome any obstacles, just like I did!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well in my case, there's still much to be done, but that won't stop me from trying.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And one day, I'd really love for the three of us to run together again, just like we did this summer. Hopefully, at a racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the three of us'll make it one day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It'll be up to them to make their dreams a reality. Their hopeful promise fades away into the summer evening's sky.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, I don't know what the future holds, but I better start by settin' an example for my juniors.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes peeled this fall. 'Cause White Lightnin's new 'n improved, and she's ready to bring da thunder!
